exposure: Levator Ani Muscle (LAM) elasticity (assessed by ES and SR)
outcome: Subjective improvement or cure of SUI
cohort: The participants were patients suffering from stress urinary incontinence (SUI).
finding: Kegel exercises significantly increased the stiffness of the levator ani muscle (LAM) as assessed by elastography, and this increased LAM stiffness was associated with an improvement in stress urinary incontinence (SUI) symptoms.
